```{r, include=F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(ECHO = F)
library(dplyr)
library(PerformanceAnalytics)
library(isotree)
library(rstatix)
library(MLmetrics)
library(kableExtra)
```

## 1. Wczytywanie danych
```{r}
data <- read.csv("HepatitisCdata.csv") |> select(-X) |> na.omit()
```

## 2. Podstawowa transformacja
### 2.1 Standaryzacja
Standardyzujemy wszystkie zmienne numeryczne (cechy 4:14)
```{r}

for (i in 4:ncol(data))
{
  col_mean <- mean(data[, i])
  col_sd <- sd(data[, i])
  data[, i] <- (data[, i] - col_mean) / col_sd
}

```
### 2.2 Uproszczenie wartości zmiennych kategorycznych
```{r}
data$Category[data$Category == "0=Blood Donor"]           = "0"
data$Category[data$Category == "0s=suspect Blood Donor"]  = "0s"
data$Category[data$Category == "1=Hepatitis"]             = "1"
data$Category[data$Category == "2=Fibrosis"]              = "2"
data$Category[data$Category == "3=Cirrhosis"]             = "3"
```

## 3. Analiza korelacji cech
```{r}
chart.Correlation(data[,4:ncol(data)], histogram=T, pch="+")
``` 

## 4. 
```{r}
chart.Correlation(data[,c("ALB", "ALP", "CHE", "BIL", "CHOL", "GGT", "PROT")], histogram=T, pch="+")
```

```{r}
cor.mat <- data[, 4:ncol(data)] |> cor_mat()
cor.mat |> cor_plot()
```
## 5. Podział na zbiory treningowe i testowe.
Wybieramy **tylko** zdrowych pacjentów.
```{r}
set.seed(42)

data$Sex <- as.factor(data$Sex)
zeros <- which(data$Category == "0")
idx   <- sample(zeros, size = round(0.8 * length(zeros)))

feature_cols <- setdiff(names(data), "Category")

data_Train <- data[idx, feature_cols]
data_Test  <- data[-idx, ]

# labels aligned with the test set (1 = anomaly, 0 = healthy)
is_outlier <- as.integer(data_Test$Category != "0")
data_Test  <- data_Test[, feature_cols]

stopifnot(nrow(data_Test) == length(is_outlier))

table(is_outlier)
summary(data_Train)
summary(data_Test)
```
## 6. Uczenie lasu losowego 
```{r}
set.seed(1)

iso_forest <- isolation.forest(data_Train)
scores     <- predict(iso_forest, data_Test)
stopifnot(length(scores) == length(is_outlier))
```

Hierachical Clustering
```{r}
print(AUC(scores, is_outlier))
```
